caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige background and consists of detailed, technical illustrations of a piece of furniture, likely a chaise lounge or sofa, shown from multiple views. At the top of the composition, there is a side elevation view of the furniture with ornately curved and decorated armrests at both ends, each featuring a large floral medallion. The body is embellished with symmetrical ornamental scrollwork and a central floral motif, and the legs have stylized animal paw feet. Below the main elevation, there are two front and rear views, depicted as rectangles with sturdy legs, each leg decorated with carved elements and small round feet. Between these two views are vertical strips containing repetitive decorative patterns, and below the main side view, there is a circular ornament with a floral design that mirrors the motifs on the armrests. The drawing is bordered by fine lines, with additional measurement markings in the lower left corner and a signature in the lower right.
title: Sofa
